literal_meaning: দ্রুত প্রবাহ বা গতির অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ
figurative_meaning_en: Onomatopoeic word indicating rapid movement or flow
example_sentences_in_english: The river flows with a rushing taratar sound.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression used in Bengali literature and everyday speech to evoke the sound and speed of flowing water or passing time.
